svg.text: Lumi Wand harness — every route by ID (Lumi_Wand_Integration 10.5.9, 2026-10-24)
Circuits, not physical paths. Drivers: KESHY (B) at all 12 seats, header pins clipped to 2 mm stubs, leads soldered to the stubs. Every disconnect is at a rail, the PCA or the cradle.
pins 1/2: 3 pigtails each, lap joints on top
power only · NO berg: leads SOLDERED
PWM rows: one 4-pin housing per LED star
I/O: GND · OE · SCL · SDA · VCC
lead SOLDERED at the top-end pads; OE-GND link
NO ground wire on any PWM run:
the PWM inputs ride across the
KESHY (B) at all 12 seats, pins clipped to 2 mm
STAR from the cradle: no rail feeds another.
GND-power and GND-logic meet only in the bay
(or at the pack). Meter them OPEN before power.
Each driver: VIN± · PWM · LED± soldered to pads.
1 k pull-down PWM to VIN- at EVERY driver
22 AWG: P and DP. 26 AWG: the rest. Cuts: 10.5.9.
